contract: Every Experience show records how ready it was when it reserved its release: cold, prepared, or built. Prepared means the verified runtime release (bytes read and SHA-256 checked, renderer payloads built) and the release's native preparation both exist when the show reserves it; anything less is cold, including native preparation without the verified release. A release whose acquisition could not read an optional object is never kept as the verified release, so the next show reads it again and retries the missing objects. Built means one of the show's first screens was also built ahead of time; SDKs that do not build screens ahead never report it. The loading shimmer shows only when the show is cold; a prepared or built show shows the authored presentation background until reveal. The reservation lasts until the show ends, not until reveal, so every screen of the show hits the same prepared release, and a release dropped from the profile while reserved is released only when the show ends.

cases.name: native preparation without the verified release
